describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile as a single quadrupedal animal with a low, arched body and a long, pointed snout. Its entire dorsal surface, sides, tail, and outer limbs are covered in large, overlapping, rounded scales that are dark brown in the center with tan to light brown edges, interspersed with irregular patches of pale pink, speckled scales on the flanks and lower sides. The head is elongated with a narrow snout ending in a dark nostril, a single visible large dark eye with a textured eyelid, and a small dark circular ear opening just behind the eye. Six pink, fleshy external gill stalks with fine feathery filaments protrude from the head and neck region, three on the visible side of the neck behind the head and three along the top of the head. The skin on the snout, around the eye, throat, and lower limbs is wrinkled and gray-brown. It stands on four short, thick, muscular limbs that end in broad feet with stout curved claws, and a long, thick, scale-covered tail extends to the left rear. The background is plain off-white with a soft shadow under the feet.
